About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Owner to own the Options product area at DriveWealth: the order, trading, and post-trade capabilities that let partners offer options to their customers through our API and FIX interfaces. You'll take options initiatives from discovery through launch with little oversight, breaking large projects into clear, prioritized work and keeping delivery on track.

You'll anticipate problems before they surface, whether a change in exchange or clearing requirements, a partner's blocking need, or a gap in how we handle exercise, assignment, and expiration. You'll design scalable solutions for them, working closely with engineering, brokerage operations, compliance, and clearing. Margin and buying-power calculations for options are a closely related domain, and you'll partner with the teams that own them.
You'll build cross-functional relationships across partner-facing, engineering, operations, and compliance teams, and keep stakeholders informed on the state and status of your projects. Success is measured by partner adoption and production usage of your capabilities, and you'll be accountable for results that impact the team and department.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and document business and technical requirements for options execution services, including API specifications, order lifecycle flows, and edge cases
  • Test and validate REST API endpoints in Postman, including request and response payloads, error handling, and regression scenarios
  • Write SQL queries to investigate trade, order, and position data, reconcile across systems, and diagnose production issues
  • Partner effectively with your design, compliance, brokerage, operations, and engineering team to build, test, and launch options features
  • Consolidate feedback from internal stakeholders and partners on their experience to continuously improve our offering
  • Own UAT planning and execution, including test cases, test data, and sign-off criteria
  • Identify, track, and create analysis of key metrics that illustrate performance
  • Management of third-party relationships including exchanges, market makers, clearing members, and technology vendors
  • Analyze options execution data (fills, rejects, cancels, exercises, assignments, expirations) to identify defects, inefficiencies, and opportunities
  • Document and maintain data mappings, API contracts, and process flows for internal teams and partners
  • Triage and drive resolution of production and partner-reported issues with clear reproduction steps and root cause analysis

You Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, business analysis, engineering, or consulting in a trading platform or brokerage environment, with exposure to equities or options trading, execution, clearing, or settlement
  • Working knowledge of listed options: contract specifications, multi-leg strategies, and the exercise, assignment, and expiration lifecycle
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex, end-to-end initiatives delivered to production
  • Ability to break down large projects, prioritize them, and estimate scope and timing accurately
  • Experience with REST API and FIX platforms
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including concise product specifications and the ability to adapt your message to partners, engineers, and executives
  • Experience analyzing data using SQL and relevant BI tools
  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate product discovery, definition, and development
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, finance, or equivalent experience
  • FINRA Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) completion, or a commitment to acquire it within the first year (with support from your manager)

Special Knowledge (Nice to Have, But Not Required)

  • Familiarity with OCC clearing and options regulatory requirements, including account approval levels, suitability, and disclosure rules
  • Familiarity with Reg T margin and options margin calculations and FINRA Rule 4210
  • Experience launching a new product or asset class, not just iterating on an existing one
  • Familiarity with the B2B2C correspondent or broker-as-a-service model, where partners are the primary customers
  • Experience with options market data, market maker relationships, or exchange connectivity
  • Background in broker-dealer clearing operations (reconciliation, exception handling, regulatory reporting) and identifying automation opportunities
  • An AI-native product mindset: regular use of tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or similar for PRD drafting, customer-call synthesis, data exploration, and prototyping

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following locations: Chicago, IL - Hybrid (repeat per location, including Hybrid or Remote)

  • This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.
  • If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Pay Range: $195,000 – $215,000 USD

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.

Work Authorization

Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.

For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.

Compensation

Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience.  If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Responsibilities

 
  1. Design, develop, and continuously enhance platforms for secure software development and software supply chain security, embedding security capabilities into code commits, CI builds, artifact management, approvals, and production releases.
  2. Design and implement automated security gates within existing development workflow management tools—including branching policies, code reviews, and end-to-end release workflows—to ensure secure application deployment.
  3. Build trusted build and release capabilities, including dependency integrity verification, artifact hash reporting and deployment-time verification, artifact immutability, provenance tracking, signature verification, and cross-environment consistency.
  4. Collaborate with security, architecture, and application development teams to translate security policies into scalable platform capabilities with low false-positive rates, phased rollout support, and policy exception mechanisms.

Requirements

 
  1. A bachelor’s degree or above, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Security, or a related field; at least 5 years of experience in backend development, security engineering, or DevSecOps platform development.
  2. Strong programming skills in Java or Go, with a deep understanding of multithreading and concurrent programming models.
  3. A deep understanding of software supply chain security, including key attack surfaces and mitigation strategies across code repositories, dependency sources, build environments, artifact repositories, and deployment workflows.
  4. An understanding of the principles behind Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Software Composition Analysis (SCA), secret scanning, and malicious code detection, with hands-on experience implementing security scanning platforms or CI/CD security gates.
  5. Familiarity with dependency ecosystems such as Maven, npm, PyPI, and Go Modules, including dependency resolution, version pinning, dependency confusion, and package poisoning risks.
  6. Familiarity with artifact management platforms such as JFrog and Harbor, with practical experience in centralized package source governance, artifact access controls, artifact immutability, and dependency and artifact integrity verification.
  7. Familiarity with GitLab, Jenkins, or other CI/CD platforms, including branch protection, code reviews, pipeline templates, build runner isolation, credential management, and release approval mechanisms.
  8. Strong cross-functional collaboration and execution skills, with the ability to translate security requirements into actionable, measurable platform solutions while balancing security risks with engineering productivity.
Why Join Us
 
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include:
  • Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
  • Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
  • Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
  • Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
  • Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

The opportunity

As a Sr. MarTech Specialist for Attribution and Performance, you will support attribution and performance measurement at Payward by owning the data and processes that keep it accurate, and by acting as the bridge between our engineers and our performance marketing team. You will form part of a wider MarTech team and partner closely with finance and compliance so that measurement stays accurate and follows our safety and compliance practices. You will also use AI as a core part of how you work, moving quickly and sharing what you learn with the team. Key responsibilities include:

  • Attribution:

    • Drive attribution across web and app, covering conversion definitions, touchpoint credit and journeys stitched together across 3rd party vendors and our inhouse data platforms.

    • Reconcile ad platform, MMP, analytics and internal numbers, and explain the gaps in plain language.

    • Investigate discrepancies caused by vendor configuration, attribution methodology, fraud or bugs in our own apps.

    • Use AI as part of your everyday workflow to speed up investigation, SQL, specs and reporting, share what works with the team and contribute to team Agent.

    • Contribute to the roadmap for the next level of attribution, such as incrementality testing, LTV-based optimisation and marketing mix modelling.

    Engineering partnership:

    • Turn performance marketing needs into clear specs and tickets for engineering, covering event design, deep links, SDK changes and server-side tracking, and review what ships.

    • Work with engineers and data owners to keep the signals ad platforms optimise on (Meta, Google and TikTok conversion APIs and postbacks) complete, deduplicated and consent-compliant.

    • Audit and standardise event naming, properties and volume, with monitoring in place to catch breakages early.

    Performance and cross-functional support:

    • Run a regular rhythm with performance marketing on attribution health, discrepancies and test readouts.

    • Put a measurement plan in place before spend goes live on new channels, launches and tests, and own the readout afterwards.

    • Support weekly and monthly reporting cycles, maintain the attribution dashboards the performance team relies on, and support spend and invoice reconciliation with finance.

    • Work directly with MMP and ad platform reps and vendor support, escalating with evidence.

    • Work with compliance to keep tracking, conversion signals and reporting aligned with Payward's safety and compliance practices, including consent, privacy (GDPR, CCPA) and financial promotion rules.

    • Set up monitoring and alerts for tracking breakages, fraud and volatility-driven spikes in traffic and conversions, such as sharp market moves, and escalate per policy.

    • Participate in cross-functional discussions with product, compliance, finance, design, data and performance marketing, and prioritise requests openly.

 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in MarTech, performance marketing technology, growth analytics or a related digital marketing field.

  • Hands-on experience with web and mobile attribution, including MMPs (such as AppsFlyer or Branch), SKAN, deep linking and web-to-app journeys.

  • Understanding of why ad platforms credit conversions differently, and experience with conversion APIs and server-side tracking for Meta, Google Ads and TikTok.

  • Comfortable working with data: SQL and a data warehouse, able to read an event schema and trace a discrepancy back to its source.

  • An AI-native way of working: you already use AI assistants and agents day to day for analysis, SQL, scripting, documentation and automation, move fast with them, check their output before relying on it, and follow our data privacy and security rules when doing so.

  • Experience working within safety and compliance practices in a regulated environment, such as consent and financial promotion rules, and monitoring data and alerts through volatile periods when traffic and conversions swing quickly.

  • Strong stakeholder management and written communication skills, with experience aligning performance marketers, engineers, data, finance and compliance around a number they might not align on.

  • Able to write a clear spec, work with engineers to deliver it and review the result.

  • Detail-oriented and process-driven, able to manage multiple workstreams and prioritise the problems that move spend decisions.

  • Genuine interest in the crypto or fintech industry.

 

Nice to haves

  • Exposure to incrementality testing or marketing mix modelling.

  • Experience building AI-assisted workflows or lightweight automations, for example with LLM APIs, scripts or agents, for reporting, QA or monitoring.

  • Familiarity with affiliate platforms (Impact.com or similar), CRM platforms, tag management and consent tooling.

  • Fintech or crypto experience.
